overview_description.description: Ravn is software that creates and delivers useful edge data wherever it’s needed, in real time. Real-time decision-making necessitates actionable edge data, but in the defence sector, actionable data is rare despite the abundance of information. Prior to choosing an option, decision-makers still rely on human operators to communicate the context and conditions that are missing from the available data.
